title: Surgical Tech T-Shirt — PRECISION IS MY SPECIALTY

A clean, professional unisex tee made as a polished, giftable statement for surgical technologists, scrub techs, and OR team members who take pride in precision and calm under pressure. Wears well outside the hospital with subtle operating-room character in the typography and spacing.

rationale: Minimal, professional treatment with a blue-accent palette to evoke the OR environment without clinical branding. Clean, all-caps typography centers the approved phrase (unchanged) for a wearable, pride-forward look. Subtle hierarchy (eyebrow, bold two-line phrase, small footer) communicates precision and composure while remaining giftable and versatile outside work.
